# Changelog

## 1.1.0 — unreleased

Additive operation receipts/idempotency, fail-closed mutation preconditions, scoped
revision tokens and structured bridge protocol 2 handshake. 108 tools; original
106 required input schemas preserved. Plugin-local bounded receipt retention and
explicit lost-response/crash boundaries. Network permissions unchanged pending a
proven configurable-loopback policy. No Beta 4/stable release or V1.2.5 enablement.

## 1.0.0 — 2026-10-15

Ownership/identity migration from Figma Designer V1.4.2 approved vendored source.
New Go module, executable/server identity and plugin display branding. All 106
tools and approved local patches retained. No new MCP features, dependencies,
bridge protocol or networking restrictions. Original import is a separate commit.
